experiments.title: Trial 1 native conditional initialization
experiments.decision: Verified bounded null result: copied multistep teacher is exact and97.5% accurate; retained one-step student improves fresh accuracy to17.6% vs9.55% reset but misses30% early gate. Both are blurred, recall0; no accepted one-step model or extension.

Separate2.5k/2.5k real-real FID20.08; single training seed; historical8k/4k FID incomparable. Full checkpoints remote; compact tensors/labels/counts/traces/source audited.

experiments.title: Two T4s · conditional DMD vs teacher pairs
experiments.decision: Teacher-pair regression has lower FID and slightly higher accuracy in this short screen, but neither passes the frozen joint gates. Teacher preflight accuracy is 97%; student grids repeat across requested classes. Next candidate: preserve pretrained class conditioning in a compatible student initialization. No extension.
experiments.protocol: 200 iterations per T4; 191 / 200 successful G updates; 500 independent label probes. Quality: 2k fresh fake / 5k D_val; Inception pool3; separate 2.5k / 2.5k real-real FID 20.08 (diagnostic, not a floor). Single seed; not directly comparable with historical 8k / 4k FID.

experiments.title: Stage 1 · control and two guidance treatments
experiments.decision: Verified null result: mechanisms and control pass, but all arms remain near chance and requested-class rows repeat. No semantic conditioning improvement.
